params.prompt:
Original detailed cinematic manga for ZERO-SUM: OMEN. Meticulous variable-weight black ink, selective crosshatching and controlled halftone, expressive anatomy and hands, clear perspective, tactile brass machinery and repaired clothing, matte gouache architectural depth, restrained colour accents. Serious action has weight and aftermath; comedy uses stillness and simplified expression. Teen-rated peril, no gore or sexualization. Preserve supplied character identity and asymmetric props. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Exact rectangular layout follows the coordinates below, with clean white gutters. Draw NO lettering, numerals, logos, sound effects, speech balloons, captions, HUD or readable signs. Leave quiet upper areas for separate lettering. Every required digit and word is a later vector layer. No imitation of a named artist or existing franchise. NIL uses they/them, RIGHT decoder, one orange hair streak, three abacus clasps, longer LEFT coat tail. Vesper has LEFT braid, two blank hat cards, seven-chamber gun. Varro is human under a repaired hound mask, with three jars. Never mirror these actors.
Colour script: slate rain, bone paper and warm amber brass; signature colour only at the focal actor.
Panel p012_01 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.35]: Gus stall under patched awning, pair left, Gus right. Three separate trays: horseshoe, cat charm, folded ward. No prices or wallet.
Panel p012_02 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.42, 0.43, 0.24]: Gus weathered hands level trays on scuffed felt; repaired hinges, kettle, clean object silhouettes.
Panel p012_03 at normalized rectangle [0.52, 0.42, 0.43, 0.24]: Vesper suspicious, coin idle; Gus practical, not saintly.
Panel p012_04 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.68, 0.9, 0.27]: NIL hand hovers over all three without touching; clean space for typed options.
Use an exact1000x1500 composition grid (scale proportionally to the output). Panel pixel boxes [x,y,w,h]: p012_01 [50, 75, 900, 525]; p012_02 [50, 630, 430, 360]; p012_03 [520, 630, 430, 360]; p012_04 [50, 1020, 900, 405]. Keep all art inside these boxes; gutters remain plain paper.
FINAL CONTINUITY: Draw ONLY this page's listed story cast: nil, vesper, gus. Gus: weathered stocky adult Bazaar fixer in BLUE bowling shirt overcream, gold chain and receipt book, warm shrewd face, no ethnic caricature. Do not add other named characters from style notes or other pages. The priest must NOT appear before the shrine entrance scene. Every mechanical readout is EMPTY SMOKED GLASS, never a portrait mirror; Civic/Audit/NaN lettering is added later. Preserve panel count, geometry and required geography. Clean 4K portrait page, no lettering, no balloons. Broad clean upper panel areas for separate text, faces/hands placed below those zones. Fine controlled ink detail at focal areas; strong black shapes and selective crosshatching; readable painted atmosphere, no glossy photorealism.
